display_long_description:
Tabletop Infrastructure VR Viewer is a powerful and intuitive virtual reality application that allows engineers, planners, and stakeholders to explore, review, and collaborate on 3D infrastructure designs. Built to complement the Tabletop Infrastructure Designer, this VR viewer brings digital infrastructure models to life in a highly interactive, spatial environment—enabling teams to engage with their projects like never before.

Once a scene is created and published using the Designer tool, it can be downloaded into the Viewer for immersive inspection and collaboration. Users can freely navigate the entire design space at scale, walking around or zooming in for a close-up view of specific structures, terrain features, and design elements. Whether it's roadways, bridges, utility layouts, or urban developments, every component of the infrastructure is accurately represented and accessible within the VR scene.

A key feature of the app is its built-in voice annotation system. Users can record voice notes while interacting with the environment, attaching them directly to objects or spatial locations. These annotations make it easy to document feedback, flag issues, or leave instructions for collaborators without disrupting the immersive flow of review. Playback of these annotations allows for asynchronous communication between team members, improving coordination across disciplines and time zones.
